**q25.** Engine: CEL (google/cel-go) wrapped by the in-repo `filter` package — `internal/filter/engine.go:13` (`NewEngine`), schema at `internal/filter/schema.go`, IR at `internal/filter/ir.go`, SQL rendering at `internal/filter/render.go`. Mechanism: the CEL expression compiles to a dialect-agnostic condition tree, then `renderer.Render` emits dialect-specific SQL + args (`filter.DialectSQLite|DialectMySQL|DialectPostgres`, `schema.go:14-16`, with per-dialect field expressions like `CONCAT` vs `||`), and each driver appends it to its WHERE clause via `filter.AppendConditions` (`internal/filter/helpers.go:9`; call sites `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:69`).

**q26.** `memo` (the memo row plus comment memo rows), `memo_relation` (both directions), `attachment`; plus `memo_share`, removed by the DB-level `FOREIGN KEY (memo_id) REFERENCES memo(id) ON DELETE CASCADE` (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:109`, `postgres/LATEST.sql:108`, `mysql/LATEST.sql:108`). Reaction rows are read for the webhook payload but not deleted.

**q27.** Mechanism: the built `dist` bundle is compiled into the binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served by Echo's static middleware plus an SPA fallback to `index.html`. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21` (embed), `:40-60` (`Serve`, static middleware + `spaFallbackMiddleware`); invoked from `server/server.go:70`.

**q28.**
```
s3presign runner — RunOnce at startup, then a 12h time.Ticker (server/server.go:159-169; server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27,29-30)
```
Unused infra: `internal/scheduler` (a full cron/job scheduler package with parser, middleware, jobs) is not imported anywhere outside its own package/tests. Also `server/runner/memopayload.Runner`/`RunOnce` is never started by the server — only its `RebuildMemoPayload` helper is called inline from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`.

**q29.** Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:151-176` (attached to the transport, `:185-190`), with token state in `web/src/auth-state.ts`. Tokens managed: short-lived JWT access token (Bearer header, localStorage, proactive + reactive 401 refresh) and an HTTP-only refresh-token cookie (`memos_refresh`) used via `authServiceClient.refreshToken` (`web/src/connect.ts:68-82`). Backend validation: `server/auth` (`authenticator.go` — `AuthenticateByAccessTokenV2`, `AuthenticateByRefreshToken`, `AuthenticateByPAT`; `token.go` — JWT parse/audience constants, PAT prefix/hashing), used by `NewAuthInterceptor`/`Authorizer` in `server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go` and `authz.go`.
